notes.title: Quick Update
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

We pushed a quick update over the weekend addressing the following issues that were pointed out.

- Reduced the alarm sounds (but only a bit because that would defeat the point, maybe???)
- Sphere visual update

TIP: If you're seeing a red sphere around you all the time you need to move back to your centre position or reset your seating position.  

Anyone seen the Newcomer on their ship yet?

Thank you for the support!

notes.title: VR Launch Options Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Thank you to those who have already tried Playing God and left us reviews providing valuable feedback!

We have pushed a quick update to address the issues people were having when launching in VR. This should now be resolved and the experience should launch accordingly when selecting the Launch in VR option.

Thank you for the support!
